Tap any cell of the crossword — it will turn purple, and the translation of the word to guess will appear at the bottom.
The number in the corner of a cell marks the start of a word. Tap it to jump to that word. If two words pass through a cell (horizontal and vertical), each tap toggles the direction.
To type Á, É, Í, Ó, Ú, Ü or Ñ, hold the corresponding key — a menu with the variant will appear. If a yellow hint is shown below, the current word contains such letters.
You earn coins for correct answers:\n• \"Letter\" — reveals one letter (10 coins)\n• \"Word\" — reveals the whole word (50 coins)

Each week you compete with 30 learners around your level. Top 7 move up, bottom 7 move down.
• Every Monday 30 learners at your level join one cohort.
• Earn XP for correct answers all week.
• Sunday 23:59: top 7 promote to a higher league, bottom 7 demote.
• 8 leagues: from Aldea perdida to Madrid.
• You can leave and return any time.
